text: Renee Good, born on this day in 1988.

8. For years, X was famously known by the internet nickname "Meth Damon”, a moniker earned from his striking physical resemblance to the actor Matt Damon, and his role in an acclaimed tv series. The comparison was ironically established at the very start of X's career; at just twelve years old, X was cast to play the younger version of Damon’s character in the 2000 Western All the Pretty Horses.
Despite this early shadow, X has since evolved into a powerhouse of independent cinema, often specializing in a "banality of evil" acting style that makes his most menacing characters feel disturbingly normal. X is also celebrated for a prolific professional partnership with his real-life wife, Y, with whom he has co-starred as a husband in a Midwestern crime saga, a brother-in-law in the 1920s Montana wilderness, and most recently, a terrifying adversary in a 2024 dystopian thriller.
